investigation_data.description: Worker bypassed LOTO procedure during maintenance. System was pressurized. Chemical spray incident. Worker had repeated this shortcut 5 times before.
Worker fell from 3 meters while working on scaffold. Safety harness was available but not used. Supervisor was not present at the time.
Electrician received shock while working on live circuit. LOTO was not applied. Work permit expired 2 days ago but work continued.
Operator's hand caught in conveyor belt during cleaning. Machine was not locked out. Guard was removed for maintenance and never replaced.
Worker collapsed in tank due to oxygen deficiency. Gas testing was not performed. Rescue plan was not in place.
Forklift collided with pedestrian in loading area. Speed limit signs were faded. Designated walkways were not marked.
Worker splashed with acid while transferring from container. PPE was not available. Emergency shower was blocked by materials.
Small fire in electrical panel due to overheating. Panel was overloaded. Maintenance was 6 months overdue. Fire extinguisher was expired.
Worker slipped on oil spill in maintenance area. Spill was reported 3 days ago but not cleaned. Warning signs were not placed.
Gas explosion during welding near storage area. Hot work permit was not obtained. Gas detectors were not functioning.
